title: Embeddings & Rerank: Mini-tour cards, annotated pipeline diagrams, and sample output screenshots
creator: Maya Singh
description: Design deliverables for a compact, developer-focused quickstart that teaches embeddings + rerank patterns with minimal cognitive load. Scope: (1) three mini-tour cards for the onboarding flow (Get embeddings, Build rerank pipeline, Inspect outputs), (2) an annotated pipeline diagram highlighting latency and cost callouts along the inference path (embedding generation, index, vector search, rerank scoring), (3) three sample output screenshots and export-ready assets (semantic search card, rerank-scored list with confidence bars, hybrid match highlights), and (4) small-screen/mobile variants and localized copy for EN/DE. Goals: reduce time-to-first-success, make tradeoffs transparent (cost vs. quality), provide assets that engineering can drop into docs and the app Quickstart modal.
screenshots_needed: Docs hero screenshot (1280x720) showing pipeline + sample output
Console embed step screenshot where user pastes key (800x480)
export_specs: SVG for diagrams (text layers left editable, outline fonts for legacy exports)
PNG @2x for all screenshots (min 1200px width for docs hero)
WebP fallback for docs site (lossy, quality 80)
Alt text and short descriptions included in a CSV for the docs deploy
acceptance_criteria: Three mini-tour cards complete with copy and annotations and approved by PM
Annotated pipeline diagram includes latency and token-cost callouts for each stage
Three sample outputs exported in required sizes and formats with alt text
Mobile variants available and verified in Chrome device simulator
Final assets uploaded to Drive and linked in PR; docs PR merged or pending merge
